title: Help test the drawer with your keyboard and screen reader
body:
Open the complete example and follow the keyboard test script. If something behaves unexpectedly, tell us the browser, operating system, assistive technology where relevant, and the exact steps. Do not claim a pass for a setup you have not tested. [Nottingham Web Design](https://webdesignnottingham.uk/) maintains the example and welcomes reproducible improvements.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Web-Design-Nottingham/keyboard-drawer-lab#readme), then run the documented example locally.
